tagline: India's financial capital and home of Bollywood, with the Gateway of India, Victorian Gothic landmarks, Marine Drive sunsets and legendary street food.
overview: Mumbai, the capital of Maharashtra on India's west coast, grew from seven islands joined by land reclamation into one of the world's largest cities. It is India's financial centre, home to the Bombay Stock Exchange, the Reserve Bank of India and the country's busiest port.

The Gateway of India, built to mark a 1911 royal visit, faces the Taj Mahal Palace hotel across the harbour. Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus, a Victorian Gothic railway station, and the Art Deco buildings along Marine Drive are both part of UNESCO World Heritage sites.

Mumbai is the heart of Bollywood, India's Hindi film industry. Visitors take ferries to the rock-cut Elephanta Caves, watch the dabbawalas deliver lunches across the city, eat vada pav and pav bhaji at Chowpatty Beach and walk Marine Drive, nicknamed the Queen's Necklace for its lights at night.
